column3: “The city of Ariel” redistributes the repeated name Ariel; the command to add year to year is combined with the recurring festivals.
“An altar hearth” translates the repeated name Ariel by its meaning.
The statements about being drunk and staggering are third-person statements in the Hebrew, rather than commands.
“O prophets” and “O seers” make addresses of descriptions identifying the eyes and heads.
The request “Please read this” is not explicitly retained.
The request to read the scroll is not explicitly retained.
“False charges” specifies the expression for emptiness or nothingness by which the righteous person is turned aside.
“Honor” renders the first occurrence of the verb for treating the name as holy.
